title: Ingress order rule input (v0.5, D31 amendment 2026-10-29, MVP-19)
description: Input of the ingress-order vectors: apps.http.servers of the Caddy JSON that Caddy's stock Caddyfile adapter produces from the operator's Caddyfile (as `schild ingress validate` reads it), plus the optional source text (informative: the gateway's test adapts it and compares with servers; the rule never reads it). Routes, matchers and handlers are checked by contract/ingress.Check (route fields group, match, handle, terminal only; every handler an object with a non-empty string handler; an invoke names a named route of its server; no invoke cycle; route lists nested at most 32 deep), every violation is `schema`. The result is {findings} with at most one finding per site route and handle_errors route (rules in ingress-order.md). Never sent anywhere.

caddyfile.description: The Caddyfile the servers were adapted from (informative).

server.description: One Caddy HTTP server (listener). Fields other than routes, errors and named_routes (listen, automatic_https, logs, ...) are allowed and ignored.
